name: edgepad
title: Edgepad
description: Manage edgepad touchpad gesture bindings, configs, service and diagnostics from the launcher.
author: black

commands.name: gestures
commands.title: Gestures
commands.description: Browse, add, edit and delete the gesture and slider bindings of a config.

commands.name: create-gesture
commands.title: Create Gesture
commands.description: Open the add-gesture form for the selected config in one step.

commands.name: settings
commands.title: Config Settings
commands.description: Edit device, edge widths, timing, block-while-typing and priority of a config.

commands.name: health
commands.title: Health Check
commands.description: Run edgepad status and doctor, inspect devices and control the service.

commands.name: cli
commands.title: CLI
commands.description: Run the remaining edgepad commands: dump, proxy, replay, daemon and the service.

preferences.name: edgepadPath
preferences.title: Edgepad Binary
preferences.description: Absolute path to the edgepad binary. Leave empty to use the first edgepad on PATH.

preferences.name: configDir
preferences.title: Config Directory
preferences.description: Folder holding the .toml configs. Leave empty for $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/edgepad, then ~/.config/edgepad.

preferences.name: serviceName
preferences.title: Service Unit
preferences.description: The systemd user unit that runs edgepad; reload uses SIGUSR1 through the session wrapper.

scripts.test: tsx test/toml.test.ts && tsx test/argv.test.ts && tsx test/report.test.ts
